newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Three hurt in S.African taxi rank shooting--police.
newsitem.headline: Three hurt in S.African taxi rank shooting--police.

text.p: Three people were wounded when unidentified gunmen fired on commuters at a taxi rank in central Pretoria during Wednesday's rush-hour, police said.
"We have three people that have been shot and wounded in this attack. The situation is tense and we have cordoned off the area," a police spokesman said.
The gunmen had opened fire with automatic pistols and an AK-47 assault rifle from a high-rise building at a taxi loading bay shortly after 4 p.m. (1400 GMT).
Three suspects had been arrested, he added.

Sixteen people have been killed in clashes between rival taxi operators over passengers and routes in the Pretoria area since July and the spokesman said the shooting appeared to be linked to the ongoing conflict.
